t: You can find a bee for every flavor of metal. If you don't see what you're looking for, it might be in a mod specific page.
每一种金属都有对应的蜜蜂。这里没看到想找的，多半在某个模组专属的页面里。
Bred from a $(l:bees/wild/crystalline)Crystalline Bee$(/l) and an $(l:bees/solitary/ashy_mining)Ashy Mining Bee$(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/wild/crystalline)石英蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/solitary/ashy_mining)灰烬开采蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。
